sentences.text: Chandrahas Kurre vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 10 June, 2024

High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Mcrc No. 3661 of 2024
 Chandrahas Kurre S/o Late Konda Kurre, Aged About 42 Years, R/o Village
 Khauna, Ward No. 17, Satnamipara Chowki, Silyari, Ps And Tehsil Dharsiva,
 District Raipur (C.G.)
 
 Versus
 State Of Chhattisgarh Through Police Station Dharsiva, District-Raipur (C.G.)
 
 (Cause title is taken from the Cis)
Heard on the application filed under Section 439 of the CrPC.
This is the first bail application before this Court filed by the applicant for grant of regular bail.

2. The applicant has been arrested on 12.03.2024 in connection with Crime No.157 of 2024,
registered at PS-Dharsiva, District-Raipur, Chhattisgarh for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 506 of the IPC.

3. Case of the prosecution, in brief, is that on 11.03.2024, written report has been lodged by the prosecutrix, aged about 36 years with the effect that on 08.03.2024, the applicant came into her house, taken her to the adjoining room and committed rape upon her thrice.
On 11.03.2024 written report has been lodged in which the offence under Sections 376 and 506 of the IPC has been lodged against the present applicant, and he has been arrested.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that present applicant is neighbour of the prosecutrix, and there was family dispute between the parties.

Report has been lodged belatedly,
and the circumstances under which the offense is said to have been committed is quite impossible.

Applicant is in jail since 12.03.2024, and final adjudication of the case will take its own time,
therefore, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the bail application.
6. Heard learned counsel for the parties.

sentences.text: 7. Considering the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, also considering overall allegation against the present applicant, nature of allegation and the manner in which the offence is said to have been committed, without commenting anything on merits of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, the bail application filed by applicant- Chandrahas Kurre, s/o Late Konda Kurre is allowed.

It is directed that he shall be released on bail on executing a personal bond in sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety of the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court, for his appearance on each date of hearing of the case during trial.
Certified copy as per rules.
